gap_analysis_scenario.name: Gap Analysis Workflow
gap_analysis_scenario.description: Template for conducting comprehensive gap analysis
steps: 1. Parse the target standard (e.g., AS9100D, ISO 9001)
2. Upload QMS documents (procedures, work instructions, records)
4. Review identified gaps by severity (CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
5. Create CAPAs for critical and high-severity gaps

audit_preparation_scenario.name: Audit Preparation Workflow
audit_preparation_scenario.description: Template for preparing for certification or surveillance audits
steps: 1. Ensure all standards are parsed and up-to-date
2. Upload all QMS documents (procedures, records, evidence)
3. Run gap analysis to identify any gaps
4. Address all critical and high-severity gaps
6. Review document coverage against standard requirements

capa_creation_scenario.name: CAPA Creation Workflow
capa_creation_scenario.description: Template for creating Corrective and Preventive Actions
steps: 1. Identify the gap or nonconformity (from gap analysis or audit finding)
3. Develop corrective action plan with timeline
4. Identify preventive measures to prevent recurrence

procedure_drafting_scenario.name: Procedure Drafting Workflow
procedure_drafting_scenario.description: Template for drafting procedures based on standard requirements
steps: 1. Identify the clause or requirement needing a procedure
2. Review standard requirements for that clause
3. Check existing documents for related procedures
4. Draft procedure using standard format (purpose, scope, responsibilities, procedure, records)
5. Ensure procedure addresses all standard requirements

standard_migration_scenario.name: Standard Migration Workflow
standard_migration_scenario.description: Template for migrating from one standard version to another
steps: 1. Compare current standard with new version
2. Identify new requirements and changed clauses
3. Run gap analysis against new standard
4. Update existing procedures to meet new requirements
5. Draft new procedures for new requirements
8. Conduct internal audit against new standard

compliance_monitoring_scenario.name: Compliance Monitoring Workflow
compliance_monitoring_scenario.description: Template for ongoing compliance monitoring and metrics
steps: 1. Set up regular gap analysis schedule
2. Track compliance metrics (coverage %, gap count, severity distribution)
6. Implement preventive actions for common issues

industry_specific_setup_scenario.name: Industry-Specific QMS Setup
industry_specific_setup_scenario.description: Template for setting up QMS for specific industries
steps: 1. Identify industry and applicable standards (e.g., AS9100 for aerospace, ISO 13485 for medical devices)
